yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: hub of the yoke handle on the column, moves roll and pitch

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), bundle shot: the yoke base seen from the front left with the MFY yoke handle mounted, base front panel to the right
mappingSource: catalog (us.mozaracing.com/products/ay210-ffb-yoke-bundle): yoke roll and pitch; DirectInput axis names not known, so the part has no input numbers
note: The same photo is the shop's gallery-1. The yoke column itself is hidden behind the yoke handle; the marker sits on the handle's hub, which turns (roll) and slides (pitch) with the column. The base front carries the switch panel (NAV/BEACON/STROBE, BATT/FUEL PUMP/PITOT, SYS/ENG, knob, GEAR, FLAPS) that the catalog lists under moza-mfy, not under this model.
